The soup bowl rests naturally on the same counter with an honest contact shadow; the counter continues toward the stock pot. No city view or identifiable interior. A close everyday kitchen scene, no isolated studio setup or composite appearance.
Subject: one plain unbranded ceramic serving bowl containing fine pale rice noodles visibly sitting in a generous amount of clear, light meat broth, a few naturally cooked pork slices and restrained fresh herbs. The liquid is plainly visible around the noodles; this is the wet soup version. No separate serving bowl of broth.
Style/medium: believable natural editorial food photography; physically convincing moist noodles, irregular cooked meat texture, thin translucent broth and simple ceramic texture. An everyday breakfast preparation setting, modest and plausible.
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2, close three-quarter view with the whole serving-bowl rim visible; the soup bowl dominates the foreground while the connected preparation counter and softly blurred pot form a small contextual background. Prefer native 1536x1024 PNG, opaque RGB sRGB.
Lighting/mood: gentle diffused natural morning light, mild shadows consistent across bowl/counter/pot/wall, quiet colors, restrained highlights.
Constraints: a fully new image. No people, hands, faces, writing, lettering, numbers, labels, menus, logos, brands, flags, watermark, border or frame. No ramen egg, creamy coconut soup, spicy red oil, separate serving broth dish or extra plated meal. No studio advertising arrangement, HDR, plastic food textures, excessive steam, synthetic repetitive noodle patterns, protected artwork or historical scene. Do not claim this is an actual photograph made in Phnom Penh.

targetText.teksti: Phnom Penhin vesihuollon uudistuksessa huomio kohdistui myös veteen, joka katosi ennen asiakkaan hanaa. Verkoston hävikkiä vähennettiin, asiakasmäärä kasvoi ja ajoittaisesta jakelusta siirryttiin jatkuvaan vesipalveluun. Samalla vesilaitoksen talous muuttui alijäämäisestä kannattavaksi. Vesihuolto ei ole vain uusien putkien rakentamista: olemassa olevan verkoston toiminta ratkaisee, kuinka paljon puhdistettua vettä todella päätyy käyttöön.
